title: Mordheim KB catalogue — catalog/campaign/recruitment-and-veterans.yaml
description: How a warband hires new warriors and when a veteran is available. The policies and the availability roll are rule knowledge; the recruits already hired and the Experience pool of a concrete warband are campaign state and live outside the KB.

recruitment_policy.description: The policies that restrict what a warband may hire or buy at a given moment.

veteran_availability.description: The procedure that says whether an experienced warrior is on the market.

effect_ids.description: Effects of this catalogue a warband's own special rules may modify.

policy.description: One recruitment policy: prose faithful to the source, plus the structured fields the application needs to apply it.

applies_to.description: The moment the policy governs: hiring a henchman, or the recruit a warband starts with.

scope.description: Machine-readable scope of the policy, when the source states one beyond its prose, e.g. `common_items_only`.

item_id.description: Canonical item the policy is about, when it is about one.

veteran.description: The veteran availability procedure. The Experience a veteran already carries is not printed here: the KB declares the pool it is drawn from and the price of each point.

roll.description: The roll that decides whether a veteran is available.

experience_pool.description: Where the Experience of the veteran comes from.

allocation.description: How it is allocated, e.g. as advances of the player's choice.

incremental_cost.description: What each Experience point of the veteran costs.

per_experience_point_gc.description: Gold crowns added per Experience point the veteran carries.
